nodes.label: conditions.csv
nodes.description: Problem list entries. Diseases, findings and social circumstances are mixed together.

nodes.label: encounters.csv
nodes.description: One row per encounter, with the claim total for that encounter.

nodes.label: immunizations.csv
nodes.description: Immunizations given during encounters.

nodes.label: medications.csv
nodes.description: Medication orders with the cost of one fill.

nodes.label: observations.csv
nodes.description: Vitals, labs and survey answers.

nodes.label: patients.csv
nodes.description: One row per synthetic patient, living or deceased.

nodes.label: payer_transitions.csv
nodes.description: Insurance coverage periods per patient.

nodes.label: payers.csv
nodes.description: Insurance payers.

nodes.label: procedures.csv
nodes.description: Procedures performed during encounters.

nodes.label: condition_groups (seed)
nodes.description: Every condition code seen in the generated data, classified by hand. category says what kind of row it is (chronic, acute, social, administrative and so on). chronic_group is filled only for codes that belong to one of the chronic condition groups. episodic = 1 marks conditions that Synthea records as short episodes, where the flag is held for 36 months after the episode ends. Built by warehouse/build_condition_groups.py from the most frequent descriptions in the data.

nodes.label: feature_dictionary (seed)
nodes.description: Source for mart_feature_dictionary. One row per model feature, in mart column order.

nodes.label: stg_conditions
nodes.description: Problem list entries, diseases and non-disease findings together.

nodes.label: stg_encounters
nodes.description: One row per encounter with its claim total.

nodes.label: stg_immunizations
nodes.description: Immunizations. Not used for cost because the encounter total already includes them.

nodes.label: stg_medications
nodes.description: Medication orders. base_cost is the cost of one fill.

nodes.label: stg_observations
nodes.description: Vitals, labs and survey answers, value kept as text.

nodes.label: stg_patients
nodes.description: One row per synthetic patient. Typed columns, no business logic.

nodes.label: stg_payer_transitions
nodes.description: Insurance coverage periods per patient.

nodes.label: stg_payers
nodes.description: Insurance payers.

nodes.label: stg_procedures
nodes.description: Procedures performed during encounters.

nodes.label: int_condition_flags
nodes.description: Chronic condition group flags on the index date, from conditions with onset before it.

nodes.label: int_cost_events
nodes.description: One row per cost event with a date and an amount. Encounter claim totals plus one fill per medication order. Procedure and immunization line items are not added because the encounter total already contains them.

nodes.label: int_cost_windows
nodes.description: Prior cost features from cost events dated before the index date.

nodes.label: int_medication_windows
nodes.description: Active and newly started medications, from orders that start before the index date.

nodes.label: int_member_index
nodes.description: One row per eligible member per January 1 index date. Eligible means alive on the index date, 18 or older, and at least 12 months of observable history before it.

nodes.label: int_observation_latest
nodes.description: Latest vital sign and lab values in the 24 months before the index date.

nodes.label: int_outcome
nodes.description: Cost of care from the index date up to the next January 1, and the top-decile label computed within each index year over eligible members.

nodes.label: int_payer_at_index
nodes.description: Payer category from the most recent coverage period that started before the index date.

nodes.label: int_procedure_windows
nodes.description: Procedure count in the 12 months before the index date.

nodes.label: int_utilization_windows
nodes.description: Encounter counts in months 1 to 12 and 13 to 24 before the index date.

nodes.label: mart_feature_dictionary
nodes.description: One row per model feature with a label, group, description, unit and type.

nodes.label: mart_member_year
nodes.description: The modeling table. One row per eligible member per January 1 index date. Keys first, then features (numeric or 0/1, built only from records dated before index_date), then the audit-only columns race and ethnicity, then the outcome columns.

leakage_checks.name: Features only use records dated before the index date
leakage_checks.detail: 7 feature models report the latest record they read for each of 97,570 member-years. 0 are on or after the index date. The closest is 1 day before it.

leakage_checks.name: Outcome cost only uses records inside the outcome year
leakage_checks.detail: 0 of 97,570 member-years have an outcome record outside [index date, next January 1). Earliest is 0 days after the index date, latest is 1 day before the next January 1.

leakage_checks.name: Last year's cost feature equals the previous year's outcome
leakage_checks.detail: 87,620 consecutive member-year pairs compared, 0 differ by more than 1 cent. A gap or overlap at January 1 would show up here.

leakage_checks.name: Cost events reconcile to the raw files
leakage_checks.detail: Cost events total $3,331,880,798. Raw encounter claim totals plus one fill per medication order total $3,331,880,798. Difference 0.0000% (limit 0.5%). Procedures and immunizations are billed inside the encounter totals and are not added again.

leakage_checks.name: Cost events match the generator's own patient ledger
leakage_checks.detail: For 2,082 living patients whose whole history is in the export, cost events total $63,796,700 and Synthea's lifetime ledger totals $63,800,943. Difference 0.0066% (limit 0.5%).

leakage_checks.name: Label prevalence is between 9% and 11% in every year
leakage_checks.detail: Prevalence ranges from 10.00% to 10.01% across 11 index years.

leakage_checks.name: Every member-year in the mart is eligible
leakage_checks.detail: All 97,570 member-years are alive on the index date, 18 or older, and have at least 12 months of history. The rule is restated in the test from the patient table.
